negative_control_policy: choose the least declared horizon at or above both finite input indices; if none exists, report CONTROL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_GRAMMAR

reduction_guard.reason: The bind is the declared completion-sensitive consumer and boundary_completion_consumer is its in-boundary branch; reduction must keep the task-declared consumer shape. Every parameter change is rechecked for grammar membership and separation.

out_of_envelope_declaration.proof_method: within_grammar_witness of any witness binding these continuations against l1-v0/v1/v2 returns false with reason BIND_CONTINUATION: every input atom of this grammar lies within the old declared index bound (delay_index_max 2), so the new continuation map is the only failing dimension

declared_bounds_note: Complete enumeration of the finite constructor product: atoms = 1 + 2*(delay_index_max+1); contexts = non-empty well-typed op sequences up to context_depth_max with a deadline only as the final op; denominator is finite and closed. Horizon 3 exceeds the raw atom index bound on purpose: it is reachable only after a bind shift, which is exactly the completion-sensitive consumer's own processing time.
